Since Riverside School is a special school, and all Riverside’s students have an Education, Health and Care Plan (EHCP), the need for a detailed report exclusively focusing on provision for SEND students does not apply since all the school’s policies and procedures apply to all students equally.

1 SEND REPORT – 2021/22 *1 GRAND TOTAL: 143 (out of 140 planned places) (i) TEAMS Teams 1,2,3 and consist of four classes, Team 4 three classes, all organised according to common levels of independence and needs within the Team, divided by key stage rather than year group.
1 SEND REPORT – 2022/23 * GRAND TOTAL: 152 (Note: Riverside increased its roll from 140 to 152 in September, 2022) (i) TEAMS Teams 1: 4 classes, Teams 2/3: 5 classes, Teams 4/5: 3 classes.

Riverside School
Riverside School, Wood Green, ILC
White Hart Lane, London - UK
Riverside School is committed to ensuring that its premises are accessible to everyone. We believe the school meets its accessibility obligations under the Equality Act 2010. The buildings and wider site have been designed in line with modern building regulations, with accessibility incorporated throughout to support pupils, staff and visitors with mobility impairments.
Riverside School’s Offer explains the care, support and specialist opportunities we provide to help every young person feel valued, develop their independence, enjoy learning and achieve their full potential.
Keep up to date with the latest news, achievements, events and important updates from across the Riverside School community.
Help us make a difference. Your donation to Out & About helps subsidise day trips and residential school journeys, giving Riverside students access to valuable experiences beyond the classroom.
Every contribution helps create opportunities for our students to build confidence, independence, friendships and lasting memories.
Thank you for supporting our students and the Riverside School community.
Help us make a difference! By donating to Out & About, you directly contribute to subsidising the cost of day trips and residential school journeys, making these invaluable experiences accessible to all students. Please consider giving today. Thank you for your generosity.

Online Safety Help for Parents
Dear Parents,As a school, we understand the importance of e-safety for our students, especially in today's digital age. We want to assure you that we are committed to creating a safe online environment for all our students. If you have any concerns or issues regarding your child's online safety or if you simply want to know more about it, we encourage you to reach out to us. Please remember that open communication is vital in addressing online safety concerns effectively. We are here to collaborate and assist you in guiding your child towards responsible and safe internet use.
We encourage you to gain familiarity with these platforms, their features, and the privacy settings available to ensure the safety of your child while using them.
Our Online Safety Policy can be found under the Wellbeing tab.
